dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Highly prominent, sharp pale-grey margins outlining dark grey-brown flight feathers with high boundary sharpness.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Diffuse transition where solid dark crown plumage meets the beginning of scalloped fringing on the upper nape.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive scalloped appearance across the entire dorsal surface created by high-contrast pale fringes on dark feather centers.
